name: Truth or Dare
source:
The story begins with a man who is suffering from depression but with drive to change. He is dissatisfied with his existence; His despair stems from the fact that he has tried practically everything in life and has gotten bored with it all. Now he faces a tremendous challenge: discovering something new and making life exciting and valuable again.
Who can help him with everything? I cordially invite you to accompany him on the journey of his life.
Furthermore, because the game is not linear in nature, you will have the opportunity to define the MC to your liking; he can be kind, he can be terrible, he can be romantic, he can manipulate and corrupt, and he can mix everything up.
It's up to you to decide what path he is going to take.

[From F95zone]
translation:
故事始于一个患有抑郁症但渴望改变的男人。他对自己的存在不满意；他的绝望源于这样一个事实：他几乎尝试了生活中的一切，并对这一切感到厌倦。现在他面临着巨大的挑战：发现新的东西，让生活再次变得令人兴奋和有价值。
谁能帮他一切？我诚挚地邀请你陪伴他走完人生的旅程。
此外，由于游戏本质上不是线性的，因此你将有机会根据自己的喜好定义MC；他可以是善良的，他可以是可怕的，他可以是浪漫的，他可以操纵和腐败，他可以把一切都混合在一起。
他要走哪条路，由你来决定。

[来自F95zone]
